commands.command: sudo pacman -Sy --needed archlinux-keyring cachyos-keyring && sudo pacman -Su
commands.explanation: Refreshes the package signing keys first, then updates everything installed. Keys go stale on a system that hasn't updated in a while, and installs fail until they're refreshed.
commands.warning: This updates your whole system, including the kernel. Take a snapshot first if you want an undo button.

commands.explanation: Installs the Brave browser using Brave's own official installer.
commands.warning: If Brave isn't in your regular repos, Brave's installer uses an AUR helper (paru, pikaur or yay) and installs from the AUR without asking again. It also refreshes your package list.
